notes: Inclusive FITS row-index window from the unique cadence mapped to catalog start through the unique cadence mapped to catalog end. Catalog markers were read as original six-decimal strings. No normalization, detrending, smoothing, interpolation, time conversion, or extra boundary cadence. Cadence indices are 0-based within the unfiltered index window and are not renumbered after QUALITY filtering. Esta reconstrucción se formula después de F0.8, pero no se ha seleccionado para mejorar sus BIC. Está motivada por una discrepancia objetiva entre la precisión decimal de los marcadores publicados y la primera cadencia incluida mediante límites numéricos literales.
